english.note: Use this for someone who moves to another country or region to make a home there; it is the common spoken choice for that meaning.

exampleSentences.english: My cousin became a settler in Canada.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 go1 ji4 man4 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6

english.meaning: person who settles in a new country
english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who moves to another country to settle there.

exampleSentences.english: My cousin is an immigrant in Canada and now lives in Toronto.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我表哥移民咗加拿大，依家住喺多倫多。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 go1 ji4 man4 zo2 gaa1 naa4 daai6 ji1 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 do1 leon4 do1
